analysis.summary: The PR introduces logic errors in discount calculations and display, specifically through incorrect operator usage for numeric values and improper fallbacks between VAT-inclusive and VAT-exclusive data.

bugs.title: Logical OR operator causes broken UI for 0% discounts
bugs.description: The developer replaced nullish coalescing (??) with the logical OR operator (||) for totalDiscountPercentage. Since 0 is a falsy value in JavaScript, a 0% discount will now be treated as an empty string, causing the UI to render a broken '-%' badge.
bugs.risk: Visual regression and incorrect data display. If a product has a zero-percent discount (e.g., a fixed-amount discount only), the UI will display a nonsensical '-%' label instead of '-0%'.

bugs.title: Incorrect fallback to Gross discount in Net price view
bugs.description: In the Net view (showVat is false), the logic now falls back to the VAT-inclusive (Gross) discount percentage if the Net percentage is 0 or missing. This is mathematically incorrect as tax rates can differ between the base price and the discount, and a 0% Net discount should not display the Gross percentage.
bugs.risk: Functional/Financial error. Users viewing Net prices (common in B2B) will see inflated or incorrect discount percentages, leading to misleading comparisons and potential compliance issues.

bugs.title: Inaccurate discount amount fallback for VAT-exclusive view
bugs.description: When showVat is false, the code falls back to product?.promoBadgePrice?.discount?.formattedValue (Gross amount) if netDiscount is missing. This causes the UI to display a VAT-inclusive discount amount to a user who is looking at VAT-exclusive pricing.
bugs.risk: High severity financial inconsistency. The discount amount displayed will not match the tax context of the prices shown on the rest of the page, misleading the customer regarding actual savings.

notBugs.reason: The renaming is consistent across the TypeScript interface and the component usage, which aligns with standard refactoring practices.

notBugs.topic: Inconsistent fallback in main price display
notBugs.reason: While the main price display (line 531) lacks the fallback added to the tags, this is likely intentional. Falling back to a Gross price in a Net view is a significant financial error, whereas falling back for a percentage/tag is often treated as a UI 'best effort'.
The field name change is consistent with typical SAP/Hybris or headless commerce API structures where formattedValue is the preferred string representation of a price.
